name: glide-radio
title: Glide Radio
description: A radio group with one dot that travels between the rings like a drop of ink, stretching as it goes.

perf.budget: Plain views; one dot driven by two shared values serves the whole group. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The dot jumps to the new ring without stretching.
a11y.screenReader: A radio group named by accessibilityLabel; each row is a radio that reads its label and description.
a11y.touchTarget: Each row is the target, at least 48 pt tall.
